items.title: Catch missing feature flags before they reach production
items.text: can now block a deployment from reaching production if you’ve declared a flag in code but haven’t created it in your project. Without that definition, your app can silently fall back to the flag’s default value, even if that turns on a feature you meant to keep off.Vercel Flags The runs when a deployment is ready. If any flags are missing, the check fails and lists them in the results, where you can create each one before redeploying.Flag Definitions PresentDeployment Check The check reads your discovery endpoint and requires to be set in your project’s environment.Flags SDKFLAGS_SECRET To turn on blocking, teams on all plans can enable the check in their project’s and mark it as required.
